name.zh: 俄克拉何马 51 号州道

tagline.en: Panhandle edge to the Arkansas line, through Stillwater and Tulsa
tagline.zh: 自锅柄地带边缘至阿肯色州界，途经斯蒂尔沃特与塔尔萨

start.en: US 60 at the Texas state line near Higgins, Texas
start.zh: 得州希金斯附近州界处的 US 60

end.en: Arkansas Highway 244 at the Arkansas state line
end.zh: 阿肯色州界处的阿肯色 244 号公路

en: SH-51 is one of the few Oklahoma routes that runs the full width of the state, and it changes personality at least four times. In the west it shares pavement with US 60 across the short-grass country of Ellis and Dewey counties. In the middle it is a plains highway through Kingfisher and Logan counties to Orlando and I-35.

East of the Interstate it becomes the road to Stillwater and Oklahoma State University, then drops through Creek County into the Tulsa metropolitan area, where it runs as an expressway and crosses the Arkansas River at Sand Springs before threading the city and heading out through Broken Arrow and Coweta.

The last third is the green quarter of Oklahoma: it crosses Fort Gibson Lake, passes Hulbert, reaches Tahlequah — the capital of the Cherokee Nation — and then climbs through the Ozark foothills to Stilwell and the Arkansas line, where it becomes Arkansas Highway 244.
zh: SH-51 是少数几条横贯俄克拉何马全境的路线之一，沿途性格至少变换四次。西段它与 US 60 共线，穿过埃利斯县与杜威县的矮草地带。中段它是一条平原公路，经金菲舍县与洛根县通往奥兰多与 I-35。
州际公路以东，它成为通往斯蒂尔沃特与俄克拉何马州立大学的道路，随后经克里克县进入塔尔萨都会区；在那里它以快速路形式运行，在沙泉跨越阿肯色河，穿城而过后经断箭与科韦塔向东。
最后三分之一是俄克拉何马绿意最浓的一角：它跨越吉布森堡湖，经过赫尔伯特，抵达切罗基族首府塔勒阔，再沿欧扎克山麓爬升至斯蒂尔韦尔与阿肯色州界，在那里变成阿肯色 244 号公路。

en: The Tahlequah area has absorbed most of the recent money. At its December 2023 meeting the Oklahoma Transportation Commission awarded a single combined contract covering two projects: a relocation of SH-82 on the north-east side of Tahlequah, and the resurfacing and shoulder-widening of seven miles of SH-51 between Tahlequah and Hulbert. The contract went to Robinson Construction of Poteau for approximately $49 million, with construction starting in late spring 2024 and running about eighteen months.

The Sand Springs crossing is next. ODOT has programmed a rehabilitation of the SH-51 bridge over the Arkansas River, 0.85 miles south of the US-412 intersection, as a 0.393-mile project let on 9 April 2026 with 120 calendar days estimated.

That bid book is a good illustration of what rehabilitation means on a river crossing of this age: crack preparation and epoxy resin above water, pneumatically placed mortar, carbon fibre-reinforced polymer, surface-applied corrosion inhibitor and deck floodcoats.
zh: 塔勒阔一带吸收了近期大部分资金。在 2023 年 12 月的会议上，俄克拉何马交通委员会发出一份合并合同，涵盖两个项目：塔勒阔东北侧 SH-82 的改线，以及塔勒阔与赫尔伯特之间七英里 SH-51 的重铺与加宽路肩。合同由波蒂奥的 Robinson Construction 承得，金额约 4,900 万美元，2024 年春末开工，工期约十八个月。
下一项是沙泉的跨河桥。俄克拉何马交通部已把 US-412 交叉口以南 0.85 英里处的 SH-51 阿肯色河大桥修复列入计划，项目长度 0.393 英里，于 2026 年 4 月 9 日发包，估算工期 120 个日历日。
那份标书很好地说明了这种年纪的跨河桥「修复」意味着什么：水面以上的裂缝处理与环氧树脂、喷射砂浆、碳纤维增强聚合物、表面涂布型阻锈剂，以及桥面封层。

en: SH-51 dates from 1 June 1927, the first generation of Oklahoma state highway numbering, and like most long state routes it reached its present extent by accretion rather than design.

Its newest piece is very recent. On 5 September 2000 the Transportation Commission approved the designation of a spur from SH-51 to SH-82 on the north-west side of Tahlequah; the three-mile road was completed in 2004, making it the newest state highway in Oklahoma.

Tahlequah continues to be where the route is actively being rebuilt around. ODOT's plan for SH-82 north of the town makes the segment between the Bertha Parker Bypass and the SH-51 Spur access-controlled, and the department is buying right of way wide enough to build a divided four-lane all the way to Gideon if traffic ever warrants it.
zh: SH-51 始于 1927 年 6 月 1 日，属俄克拉何马州道编号的第一代；与多数长途州道一样，它达到今日的规模靠的是逐步累积而非通盘设计。
它最新的一段非常晚近。2000 年 9 月 5 日，交通委员会批准在塔勒阔西北侧划定一条自 SH-51 至 SH-82 的支线；这条三英里的道路于 2004 年建成，成为俄克拉何马最新的州道。
塔勒阔至今仍是路线周边持续重建的地方。俄克拉何马交通部对该镇以北 SH-82 的规划，使伯莎·帕克绕行道与 SH-51 支线之间的路段成为出入受控路段；该部门正在征购足够宽的路权，以便在交通量需要时一直修到吉迪恩的四车道分隔式公路。

value.en: Approximately $49 million for SH-82 relocation plus seven miles of SH-51 resurfacing and shoulders, awarded December 2023
value.zh: 约 4,900 万美元，涵盖 SH-82 改线与 SH-51 七英里重铺加宽路肩，2023 年 12 月签约

figures.source: Oklahoma Department of Transportation, 'SH-82, SH-51 projects near Tahlequah awarded', 5 December 2023

label.en: Arkansas River bridge rehabilitation, Sand Springs
label.zh: 沙泉阿肯色河大桥修复

value.en: 0.393 miles, let 9 April 2026, 120 calendar days estimated
value.zh: 0.393 英里，2026 年 4 月 9 日发包，估算 120 个日历日

value.en: Designation approved 5 September 2000; the three-mile spur was completed in 2004
value.zh: 2000 年 9 月 5 日批准划定；三英里支线于 2004 年建成

why.en: ODOT publishes project-level mileage rather than a certified per-route total, and no state-published length for SH-51 could be verified this session.
why.zh: 俄克拉何马交通部公布的是项目层级里程，而非按路线的认证总里程；本次未能查证到该州公布的 SH-51 长度。

timeline.en: SH-51 is designated on 1 June in Oklahoma's first generation of state highway numbering.
timeline.zh: 6 月 1 日，SH-51 在俄克拉何马第一代州道编号中划定。

timeline.en: The Transportation Commission approves the SH-51 Spur at Tahlequah on 5 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 5 日，交通委员会批准塔勒阔 SH-51 支线。

timeline.en: The spur is completed, becoming the newest state highway in Oklahoma.
timeline.zh: 支线建成，成为俄克拉何马最新的州道。

timeline.en: Work begins on seven miles of resurfacing and shoulders between Tahlequah and Hulbert.
timeline.zh: 塔勒阔与赫尔伯特之间七英里的重铺与路肩工程开工。
